choice.basis: The chart title is 'Public Service Feedback Share by Category' and the routing criterion is the highest feedback share. The printed percentage inscriptions above each marker are the explicit share values: Service Quality 41%, Service Cost 46%, Service Design 51%, Support Access 42%, Service Delivery 36%, Other 10%. The largest printed share is 51% for Service Design. (The vertical 'Value' axis positions do not match these percentages, but the printed percentages are the direct share labels and are the supported reading.)
choice.option_label: Route Service Design to public feedback priority follow-up
